name: SPT-CL J0354-6032 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0354-6032, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj03546032-webb
story: A rich cluster of galaxies, one of the massive clusters in Webb's SLICE survey (Strong LensIng and Cluster Evolution), which traces how galaxy clusters formed over time.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0354-6032 is a target of Webb program 5594 at RA 03 54 38.0, Dec -60 32 32 (matches the pointing)
SPT-CL J0354-6032 is a rich galaxy cluster
The SLICE survey images massive galaxy clusters to track cluster formation history
SLICE stands for Strong LensIng and Cluster Evolution
